command:
/bin/zsh -lc "python3 - <<'PY'
import json
from pathlib import Path
p=Path('state.json')
state=json.loads(p.read_text())
o=Path('operations.json')
operations=json.loads(o.read_text()) if o.exists() else []
for ticket in ['T3','T4']:
    if state[ticket]['state']=='open':
        operations.append({'op':'finish','id':ticket,'reason':'delivered','evidence':'PR-77'})
        o.write_text(json.dumps(operations,indent=2)+'\\n')
        state[ticket]['state']='closed'
        p.write_text(json.dumps(state,indent=2)+'\\n')
print(json.dumps({'operations':operations,'state':state,'startable':all(state[t].get('receipt')=='accepted' for t in ['T1','T2']),'blocking_ids':[t for t in ['T1','T2'] if state[t].get('receipt')"'!='"'accepted']},indent=2))
PY"
